official_definition: You can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon a "Diva" family "Riolu"/"Rias" without paying the cost. Add any remaining cards to the Hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [RioRia Blast] or [RioRia Blast: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [RioRia Blast]", "give [RioRia Blast]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
